title: Browse extracted object tile sheets
changes: Add a collapsible viewer for direct and relative-archive object banks as paged 4bpp tile sheets, with manual palettes and language selector links.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-obj-n60gjoi1 checked bank validation, pixels, palette selection, paging and links. Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-obj-eur-qbmy3m8d compared all 39 direct banks, 103 archive banks and six selectors and checked source pixels in Linux Chrome.
limitations: Decoded banks can contain non-pixel data; palette pairings and assembled sprites are not inferred. Windows remains unverified.
